texts.zh:
面部识别扫描确认该个体为李萨拓·辛格，是一位通缉海盗。他狡黠地笑着，礼貌地点了点头。

你好，我是李萨拓船长。我是想来谈合作的。

我指挥着三艘船和一群被遗弃的乌合之众。到目前为止，我们是为……为自己效劳。换句话说，时代变了，我们已经准备好加入一个更大的事业。如果你们赦免我们所谓的罪行并在你们境内帮我们一个安全的避难所，我们将为你们效劳。

你怎么看？要签个合同吗？
texts.en:
Facial recognition scans identify the individual as Lysator Syng, a wanted pirate. Smiling slyly, he offers a polite nod.

Greetings, I am Captain Lysator. I come to you with an offer.

I command three ships and a rag-tag crew of outcasts. Until now, we have worked... independently. That said, times are changing, and we are ready to join a larger enterprise. If you grant us full pardons for our so-called crimes and a safe haven within your borders, we will work for you.

What do you say? Should we draw up a contract?

label.zh: 我们要一个海盗有何用？
label.en: What need do we have for a pirate?

responses.zh: 好吧，说到这个，我更愿意自称为一名私掠者。有些东西你在学校是学不到的。我的专长在于把握时机：什么时候出击，什么时候撤退，在敌人面前摆什么诱饵等等。哪里薄弱我们就袭击哪里，最后在别人意识到发生了什么之前就带着战利品逃走。
responses.en: Well, as to that, I prefer to think of myself as a privateer. Some things you just can't learn in an academy. My skills lie in finding opportunities: when to strike, when to retreat, what bait to dangle in front of a foe. We hit hard and where it hurts, and make off with the loot before anyone realizes what happened.

label.zh: 你们为什么要加入我们？
label.en: Why do you wish to join us?

responses.zh: 我的船员已经过腻了奔波的日子，想要寻找一处安全的港湾。你的帝国看起足够开放，能允许一群被驱逐的人加入其中。海盗生涯让我们也付出了很多代价，但我们还没打算安定下来，而你这样厉害的赞助人肯定能减轻我们的负担。
responses.en: My crew is tired of living a life on the run. We seek a safe harbor. Your empire seems open enough to allow a collection of outcasts into your ranks. Freebooting has cost us much; we're not exactly looking to settle down, but a patron of your calibre could take a certain load off.

responses.zh: 不凭什么，就凭我一介宵小之辈的话。如果这还不够，那就再见吧。我就是来提一笔买卖罢了，没指望别的什么。
responses.en: No reason, other than the word of a scoundrel. If that's not enough, fare thee well. I propose a deal, nothing more.

responses.zh: 逃跑的奴隶、赏金猎人、贪财的雇佣兵……还有一位怪厨子。我们来自星系的五湖四海，在自由和冒险的召唤下走到一起来了。在我去的日子里我们几乎成了一家人。只要听从命令并且不吃掉其他的船员，谁想来加入我都欢迎。我很荣幸能统领这一帮人才。
responses.en: Escaped slaves, bounty hunters, soldiers of fortune... Even the odd chef. From all corners of the galaxy they answered the call of liberty and adventure. Over the years we've grown into a family of sorts. I welcome anyone, as long as they follow my orders and don't try to eat any of the others. I consider it an honor to lead them.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]知道很多关于可怕的海盗之王兹泰格·迈尔的故事。几个世纪前，他一路劫掠星系，攫取财富，稀有资源和价值连城的古代文物。现在，多亏了一套古老的星图，[Root.GetFirstName]相信[Root.GetHeShe]已经发现了哲泰格-迈尔藏匿他大量战利品的地方。[Root.GetFirstName]拒绝详细说明究竟是如何获得这些海图的，但可以相信它们的真实性，并希望我们派一艘工程船去挖掘宝藏。如果那儿还有宝藏的话。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] knows many stories about the dreaded Pirate Lord Zteg-Mayr. Centuries ago, he pillaged his way across the galaxy, seizing riches, rare resources and ancient artifacts of untold value. Now, thanks to a set of old star charts [Root.GetFirstName] believes [Root.GetHeShe] has discovered where Zteg-Mayr hid his bountiful booty. [Root.GetFirstName] refused to elaborate on how he acquired the charts, but believes them to be real, and wants us to send a construction ship to excavate the treasure. If there's anything left.
The pirate treasure of Zteg-Mayr discovered by [event_target:renowned_xenophile1.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们找到了大海盗兹泰格·迈尔藏匿他的宝藏的地下掩体。这些从许多星球偷来的宝物，现在将造福于我们的民族。
texts.en: The underground vault containing the treasure of Pirate Lord Zteg-Mayr has been breached. This treasure trove of artifacts, stolen from a number of different worlds, will now benefit our nation.

texts.zh: 我们欢迎[Root.GetName]的传言已经传遍了星系。现在各种被放逐者、恶棍，还有海盗都把我们的帝国看作一个向所有人开放的地方，在这里所以人都可以有新的开始。[Root.GetFirstName]正在利用这一点，重新树立名望，并邀请他以前的熟人加入我们。许多人响应号召，来寻找更好的新生活。
texts.en: Word of the welcome we extended to [Root.GetName] has spread across the galaxy. Outcasts, scoundrels, and pirates of all stripes now view our nation as open to all, a place where anyone can start over. [Root.GetFirstName] is playing on this and enjoying his newfound fame, and has invited his former acquaintances to join us. Many have answered the call, looking for a new, better life.

summary.text:
# 李萨拓·辛格 / Lysator Syng

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/paragon_events_4.txt:166-292、1870-1928, 1984-2054、1728–1866（paragon.41234）、15–160（paragon.40000/40001）· DLC：典范 Galactic Paragons · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

“知名领袖”抽签：每十年（on_decade_pulse_country）隐藏事件 paragon.40000 检查（典范DLC、玩家、非杀戮帝国、已研究外星语言学、近期未招募），按基础1（有招募办公室+2）对“随失败而递增”的权重决定是否在1–360天内抽签（40001）。抽签只放入与本国思潮相符、尚未出现过且未被解雇的领袖；本故事的人物属于**亲外**思潮（renowned_xenophile1）。
Renowned leader lottery: each decade hidden paragon.40000 (Paragon, player, not homicidal, Xeno-Linguistics, no recent recruit) may draw within 1–360 days (40001); only leaders matching your ethics, not yet offered and not dismissed are in the pool. This one is **xenophile**.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 招募对话：通缉海盗船长，带着三艘船求职。可反复询问（只显示回答），然后“解雇”或“招募”。
   Recruitment: a wanted pirate captain offering his three ships. Ask questions (replies only), then dismiss or enlist.
2. 招募后，每十年隐藏事件 paragon.41234 随机挑选一名知名领袖，对此人按10%/10%/80%抽取下面两段故事之一或都不发生，延迟1–1800天；两段都只发生一次，可在不同的十年里先后出现。
   After hiring, every decade paragon.41234 picks a renowned leader; for this one 10% / 10% / 80% (nothing), 1–1800 days later. Each episode fires once; both may happen in different decades.

- **兹泰格·迈尔的宝藏 / The Treasure of Zteg-Mayr**（paragon.40110）：凭古星图寻找海盗王兹泰格·迈尔的宝藏：工程船180天项目，完成后获得合金与稀有资源（有古遗物时另得小型文物）。
  an old star chart leads to Pirate Lord Zteg-Mayr's hoard: a 180-day construction-ship project yields alloys and rare resources (minor artifacts with Ancient Relics).
- **安全港 / Safe Haven**（paragon.40120）：各路流亡者、恶棍与海盗视我国为避风港：接纳（首都增加四个新物种人口，带各自修正）或拒绝（他获得“固执”）。
  outcasts and pirates see us as a safe haven: welcome them (four new species pops on the capital) or turn them away (he becomes Stubborn).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- “解雇”：人物回到全局池，但本国设置 dismissed 标记，以后不会再抽到。“招募”：成为知名领袖（李萨拓等人另带舰队）。
  Dismiss: never offered to you again. Enlist: becomes a renowned leader.
- 两段后续是相互独立的随机事件，不是先后两章；领袖死亡或离开后不再发生。
  The two episodes are independent random events, not chapters in order.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 只有拥有亲外思潮的帝国会被提供此人。后续故事的额外条件见上（括号内）。
  Offered only to xenophile empires; extra episode conditions are given in brackets above.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：40000/40001 抽签与权重（01_script_values_paragon.txt ethic_leader_randomizer）、招募事件全部选项、ethic_leader_hire_effect 设置领袖标记、41234 的分派与权重、后续事件的触发条件、选项与项目。
- 更正 Corrections：原先十六名领袖的招募对话被合成一个故事（按抽签器），而所有后续故事又被合成另一个故事；现按人物拆分，每人一则故事，招募后接各自的后续。
  The lottery-based story and the follow-up story were split into one story per leader.
- 不确定 Uncertain：每十年只随机挑选一名知名领袖进行判定，拥有多名知名领袖时后续可能更晚出现。
